card.title: Dozens of Local Police Officers Were at Trump’s Rally. Very Few Were Watching a Critical Area....
card.description: Local law enforcement officials, present in abundance, said they were not assigned security duties around a warehouse used by a man who tried to kill former President Donald Trump.

image.alt: Pennsylvania State Police and other security agencies investigate the scene after the attempted assassination of former President Donald J. Trump in Butler, Pa., last week.
